JoinB2B matches the companies depending on their business purpose. 

When registering at JoinB2B, the companies are asked about their registration purpose (B2B purpose). For example, if company “A” selected its B2B purpose as “to find a sub-contractor”, while company ”B” selected its B2B purpose as “to become a sub-contractor”, then the unique matching system of JoinB2B introduces these two companies to each other. The companies are able to see the list of the companies matching their B2B purpose easily at the right side of the website. 

JoinB2B matches the companies depending on products/services that they offer and products/services that they demand.

For example, if company “A” is offering a pen while company “B” announces a tender for purchasing a pen, then the system will automatically introduce these two companies to each other. System matches these two companies because their offers and demands are relevant to each other. 

Join B2B provides messaging services to its users to help them to directly, without any obstacles contact each other.
